paragraphs: Abba Peniamin, a Tanna of a baraita.

He is mentioned at the end of Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 3:3. Yalkut HaMakhiri on Psalms 25:14 cites Peniamin saying, “Enough time for her to extend her hand.” The source is Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:2, where the name is Minimin.

notes.text: The supplied שהושיטם ידה is awkward. Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:2 reads “for her to extend her hand and take a loaf of bread from the basket.” The notice gives Peniamin in one witness and Minimin in the other; the current parallel spells Minyamin.
